symbols.tooltip: Up to six symbols, for example AAPL, MSFT, HSBA.L@london. A symbol without @exchange uses the USA session. Other exchanges: london, paris, frankfurt, tokyo, hongkong, toronto. Only the first six are shown.

refresh-interval.tooltip: How often to ask Yahoo for new prices. A rate limit waits at least 10 minutes. A request that gets no response is tried again after 30 seconds.
